pins.name: 5V
pins.notes: Red wire. Needs 5 V: use VIN. Check the wire colours on your cable

pins.name: TX
pins.notes: Green wire. UART: the part sends data here. Connect to an ESP32 RX pin (115200 baud, 3.3 V level)

pins.name: RX
pins.notes: White wire. UART: the part receives data here. Connect to an ESP32 TX pin

sources.title: Benewake TFmini-S product manual
sources.section: Supply 5 V; UART 115200 baud, LVTTL 3.3 V; range 0.1 to 12 m
